# Objective 1: Identify and describe the farm technologies currently used by smallholder vegetable farmers in Ormoc City over the past ten years from 2014 to 2024

### Sociodemographic profile {.unnumbered}

```{r}
df |>
  select(
    sex:hh_head,
    hh_size,
    nonfarm_income,
    onfarm_income_yr,
    offfarm_income_yr,
    area_ha,
    land_type,
    -status
  ) |>
  tbl_summary(
    by = sex,
    statistic = list(all_categorical() ~ "{p}% (n = {n})"),
    type = list(hh_head ~ "categorical"),
    missing = "no",
    label = list(
      age ~ "Age",
      civil_status ~ "Civil status",
      ethnicity ~ "Ethnicity",
      educ_attainment ~ "Educational attainment",
      hh_head ~ "Household head",
      hh_size ~ "Household size",
      nonfarm_income ~ "Non-farm income",
      onfarm_income_yr ~ "On-farm income",
      offfarm_income_yr ~ "Off-farm income",
      area_ha = "Land area (ha)",
      land_type = "Land type"
    )
  ) |>
  bold_labels() |>
  as_kable_extra(linesep = "") |>
  kable_minimal() |>
  kable_styling(
    full_width = F,
    fixed_thead = T,
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed", "responsive")
  )
```


### Crops planted {.unnumbered}

```{r}
crops_planted_dta <-
  df |>
  select(sex, crops_planted) |>
  str_separate(var_name = crops_planted) |>
  mutate(
    crops_planted = case_when(
      str_detect(crops_planted, "chinese") ~ "chinese cabbage",
      str_detect(crops_planted, "chili pepper") ~ "chilli pepper",
      str_detect(crops_planted, "sweet pepper") ~ "sweet pepper",
      str_detect(crops_planted, "pepper") ~ "chilli pepper",
      str_detect(crops_planted, "coconut") ~ "coconut",
      TRUE ~ crops_planted
    )
  )

p_crops_planted <-
  plot_pct_by_sex(
    df = crops_planted_dta,
    category_var = crops_planted,
    ncol = 2,
    x_max = 0.6
  )

## saving plot
ggsave(
  plot = p_crops_planted,
  filename = "plot/p_crops_planted.jpeg",
  width = 10,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 400,
  unit = "in"
)

## display plot
knitr::include_graphics("plot/p_crops_planted.jpeg")
```

### Source of information {.unnumbered}

```{r}
info_source_dta <-
  df |>
  select(sex, starts_with("src_")) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = src_lgu_cao:src_other,
    names_to = "info_source"
  ) |>
  filter(value > 0) |>
  mutate(
    info_source = str_remove_all(info_source, "src_"),
    info_source = str_replace_all(info_source, "_", " ")
  ) |>
  group_by(sex, info_source) |>
  summarise(n = sum(value, na.rm = T)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  group_by(sex) |>
  pct_label(n) |>
  ungroup()

p_info_source <- plot_bar_by_sex(
  df = info_source_dta,
  category_var = info_source,
  x_max = 0.4
)


## saving plot
ggsave(
  plot = p_info_source,
  filename = "plot/p_info_source.jpeg",
  width = 10,
  height = 7,
  dpi = 400,
  unit = "in"
)

## display plot
knitr::include_graphics("plot/p_info_source.jpeg")
```





# Objective 2: Analyze the socioeconomic determinants influencing technology adoption among smallholder vegetable farmers.

```{r}
library(margins)
library(modelsummary)

## formula
adop_socio_fxn <- as.formula(adopt ~ .)

## logistic regression with weights
model_adopt <- glm(
  formula = adop_socio_fxn,
  data = reg_df,
  family = binomial,
  weights = ifelse(adopt == 1, 77 / 23, 1),
  na.action = na.omit
)

## marginal effects
model_adopt_marginal_eff <- margins(model_adopt)

## model summary list
models_adopt <- list(
  "Logit" = model_adopt,
  "Odds Ratio" = model_adopt,
  "Marginal effects" = model_adopt_marginal_eff
)

## regression table
modelsummary(
  models_adopt,
  exponentiate = c(FALSE, TRUE, FALSE),
  stars = TRUE,
  title = "Socio-demographic factors affecting technology adoption",
  fmt = 3,
  estimate = "{estimate} {stars}<br>({std.error})",
  statistic = NULL,
  gof_ma = c("nobs", "aic", "bic", "r2.tjur", "rmse", "F", "logLik"),
  notes = list(
    "Significance levels: + p < 0.10, * p < 0.05, ** p < 0.01, *** p < 0.001"
  ),
  coef_map = c(
    "(Intercept)" = "Constant",
    "sexMale" = "Sex (Male)",
    "age" = "Age",
    "civil_statussingle" = "Civil Status: Single",
    "educ_attainmentHigh school and higher" = "Education: High school",
    "hh_size" = "Household Size",
    "hh_org_memberYes" = "Org Membership",
    "attend_training5yrYes" = "Attended training",
    "aware_newtechYes" = "New tech awareness",
    "summ_percep" = "Perception Score",
    "summ_know" = "Knowledge Score",
    "summ_practice" = "Practice Score"
  )
)
```



# Objective 3: Investigate the barriers hindering the adoption of farm technologies.

Still need to find variables as barriers to adoption


```{r}
df |>
  select(no_time_busy:no_need) |>
  View()
summarise(across(everything(), ~ sum(is.na(.))))
```

```{r}
## formula: adopt explained by barriers
adop_barriers_fxn <- as.formula(
  adopt ~ .
)

## logistic regression
model_adopt_barriers <- glm(
  formula = adop_barriers_fxn,
  data = barrier_df,
  family = binomial,
  weights = ifelse(adopt == 1, 77 / 23, 1),
  na.action = na.omit
)

model_adopt_barriers |> summary()

## marginal effects
model_adopt_barriers_marginal <- margins(model_adopt_barriers)

## model summary list
models_adopt_barriers <- list(
  "Logit" = model_adopt_barriers,
  "Odds Ratio" = model_adopt_barriers,
  "Marginal effects" = model_adopt_barriers_marginal
)

## regression table
modelsummary(
  models_adopt_barriers,
  exponentiate = c(FALSE, TRUE, FALSE),
  stars = TRUE,
  title = "Barriers to technology adoption",
  fmt = 3,
  estimate = "{estimate}{stars}\n({std.error})",
  statistic = NULL,
  gof_ma = c("nobs", "aic", "bic", "r2.tjur", "rmse", "F", "logLik"),
  notes = list(
    "Significance levels: * p < 0.05, ** p < 0.01, *** p < 0.001"
  )
)
```
